name: alex-act-core
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin. Installs 40 reusable framework skills and 12 slash-command prompts covering epistemic discipline (critical thinking, problem-framing audit, anti-hallucination, deep review), document converters, security and privacy, tooling awareness, git/lint/mcp, authoring and engineering craft, and the plugin-management operational surface. Composes with the Alex ACT constellation (illustrator, enterprise, msft plugins). Core also authors 17 ACT instructions (15 always-on, 2 pattern-applied), which a plugin install cannot deliver because plugin.json has no instructions component field; run /install-constellation after installing to bootstrap the fifteen load-bearing ones to ~/.copilot/instructions/, read by both the Copilot CLI and VS Code Chat. Content ships through evidence-gated Steward proposals per Alex_ACT_Steward/constellation/act/CURATION-RULES.md. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward.
